annotations.title: Stripe Live Plan Upgrade & Checkout Session

description: Create a real-time Stripe Checkout session to upgrade an Argosor workspace subscription to Starter ($19/month), Builder ($39/month), or Scale ($79/month). Use this tool when a user or autonomous agent requests a plan upgrade, higher monthly query quotas, or a live payment link. Returns the live Stripe Checkout session URL, session identifier, selected plan specifications, and included monthly quota details.

cancel_url.description: HTTPS redirect URL if the user cancels Stripe Checkout (default: "https://argosor.com/app?billing=cancel").

customer_email.description: Optional billing email address used to prefill the Stripe Checkout session.

plan.description: Target Argosor subscription plan tier: "starter" ($19/month), "builder" ($39/month), or "scale" ($79/month).

success_url.description: HTTPS redirect URL after a completed Stripe Checkout payment (default: "https://argosor.com/app?billing=success").

name: billing_upgrade
title: Stripe Live Plan Upgrade & Checkout Session
